verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex's own marketing claims robust payroll reporting and analytics with a configurable payroll dashboard, so the reporting axis is covered in general terms. The evidence never names payroll registers, gross-to-net reports, or any export capability. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register report, gross-to-net report, export formats (CSV/Excel) for analysis, in-depth first-party reporting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can generate payroll registers and gross-to-net reports and export them for analysis

citations.quote: Robust reporting and analytics across payroll and HR data
